# Company Enrichment API

> Enrich any domain into a full company profile with firmographics and buying signals.

Part of the **DataLeads** API suite (Business category). Requests render in a real browser with anti-bot handling and protected-page support built in - no proxies to manage, no infrastructure to run.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/company` | V1 Company |
| POST | `/company/signals` | V1 Company Signals |

## Quick start

```bash
curl -X POST https://data.dataleads.pro/v1/company \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY", "url": "https://stripe.com"}'
```

Replace `YOUR_CLIENT_KEY` with your key. Get one at [https://data.dataleads.pro](https://data.dataleads.pro) - free tier included.

## MCP server

- **Remote (Streamable HTTP):** `https://data.dataleads.pro/mcp/company-enrichment`
- **Stdio (Docker):** `docker run -e DATALEADS_API_KEY=yourkey ghcr.io/dataleads/company-enrichment-mcp:latest`
